Definition: from G1537 and G3525; (figuratively) to rouse (oneself) out of stupor:--awake.
BiblicalUsage: The word eknḗphō carries the sense of awake. In 1 Corinthians 15:34, the text says "Awake to righteousness."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, eknḗphō means awake, nothing more and nothing less.
